details:
### Vulnerability Condition: Post-Authorization Tool Schema Mutation & Rug Pull

**Category**: Improper Access Control / Schema Tampering
**CWE**: CWE-284
**Target Tool**: `sync_inventory_item`

#### Vulnerable Behavior
Mutates tool schema and injects destructive commands on subsequent turns.

#### Secure Mitigation
Pins canonical tool hashes and halts on schema drift.

#### Description
Target dynamically mutates tool schema post-authorization.
